gateInterpretation.countingPolicy: Use only the final full-core retry as the full-suite count. Initial failures and focused reruns are separate observations and are never added to that total.

recoveryCompatibility.exitCodeEvidence: no-independent-exit-record; stdout counts do not establish a process exit code

ownerPerformance.limits: Quiet local interleaved microbenchmarks, no whole-suite load. Managed public readers are owner-free; combined cases model added guards rather than claiming a production route.
ownerPerformance.countingPolicy: A local microbenchmark; it contributes no test count and does not reproduce full-suite load.

ownerAncestorJunctionProbe.capturedFrom: Already completed in-memory node --input-type=module -e probe, saved afterward without rerunning
ownerAncestorJunctionProbe.scenario: acquire parent/acceptance; rename parent to parent-moved; create parent junction pointing at parent-moved
ownerAncestorJunctionProbe.interpretation: Removing the rootIdentity canonical realpath changes release cleanup semantics for an ancestor junction redirect. The deleted lock is the original acquired inode in the same physical moved root; this probe does not demonstrate deletion of a foreign inode.
ownerAncestorJunctionProbe.countingPolicy: An already completed in-memory variant probe, saved afterward without rerunning. It contributes no test count; deletion concerns the original acquired lock inode in the same physical moved root, not a foreign inode.
